newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan to lower 1996 GDP growth to 5.8 pct - paper.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to lower 1996 GDP growth to 5.8 pct - paper.

text.p: Taiwan will lower its 1996 gross domestic product (GDP) growth forecast to around 5.8 percent from the previous 5.89 percent, the Economic Daily News said on Monday.

The newspaper quoted officials in the cabinet's Directorate General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics as saying they will lower the 1996 GDP forecast because the third-quarter GDP growth was not likely meet the earlier forecast of 6.09 percent.
